# Data

## Import Data

```{r Import Data}
raw_data <-read_sav("data/2012_ders_raw.sav") # import raw data

```


## View Data 

```{r}

View (raw_data)  
```


## Data Preparation

To prepare the data for analysis, I need to do the following: 

- remove columns that I will not be using
- rename the questionnaire items
- remove the # at the end
- re-code the demographic variables 
- remove participants who do not identify as Black or White 

I typically use a single function like the one below:

```{r Data Cleaning and Wrangling}


cleaned_dataset_1 <- raw_data %>% 
                select (ID:College_Year, eat = "CTQ1#", takecare="CTQ2#",
                        callednames="CTQ3#", drunkorhigh="CTQ4#", special="CTQ5#",
                        dirtyclothes="CTQ6#",loved="CTQ7#",wasntborn="CTQ8#",hithard="CTQ9#", 
                        bruises="CTQ10#", punished="CTQ11#", helpfulfam="CTQ12#", insults="CTQ13#",
                        phyabused="CTQ14#", beaten="CTQ15#", hated="CTQ16#", closefam="CTQ17#",
                        sextouch="CTQ18#", sexthreat="CTQ19#", sexdo="CTQ20#", molest="CTQ21#",
                        emotabused="CTQ22#", doctor="CTQ23#",sexabused="CTQ24#", famsup="CTQ25#") %>%
#Re-code the levels for each factor/categorical variable
                mutate(Sex = fct_recode(as.factor(Sex), Male = "1", Female = "2"), 
                        Ethnicity = fct_recode(as.factor(Ethnicity), NH = "1", Hisp = "2"),
                        Race = fct_recode(as.factor(Race), NatAmer = "1", Asian = "2", 
                                          Black = "3", NatHaw_PacIsl = "4",
                                          White = "5", Bi_Multiracial = "6", Other = "7"),
                        race_2 = fct_recode(as.factor(race_2), NatAmer = "1", Asian = "2", 
                                           Black = "3", NatHaw_PacIsl = "4",
                                          White = "5", Bi_Multiracial = "6", 
                                          Other = "7", Lat_Hisp = "8"),
                       College_Year = fct_recode(as.factor(College_Year), freshman ="1", 
                                                 sophomore ="2", junior = "3", senior = "4", 
                                                 posbac ="5", other = "6"),
#Change the decimal places displayed to 2 decimal places
                        Age = format(round(Age, 2), nsmall = 2))
                       


```


However, that isn't the most readable for others. Below is code for each step of the data preparation process for this project.

```{r Remove #}

# remove "#" at the end of column names
clean_data_1 <- raw_data |> 
                  rename_with( ~ gsub("#", "", .x))
```


```{r Remove Columns}

# keep demographic and CTQ measurement variables
clean_data_2 <- clean_data_1|> 
                  select (ID:Race,
                        College_Year,
                        CTQ1:CTQ9,
                        CTQ11:CTQ15,
                        CTQ17:CTQ21,
                        CTQ23:CTQ28) 
```


```{r Select Participants}

#Keep participants who select Black or White for their race. 

#Race coding:
# Native American = "1", Asian = "2", Black = "3", NatHaw_PacIsl = "4",
# White = "5", Bi_Multiracial = "6", Other = "7"

#Keep rows where race is Black or White
clean_data_3 <- clean_data_2 |> 
                  filter (Race == 3 | Race == 5
                          )

```


```{r Rename the CTQ variables}

# renamed CTQ variables/columns to match with measurement items
clean_data_4 <- clean_data_3 |> 
                  rename (
                    PN1eat = 'CTQ1',
                    PN2careprotect = 'CTQ2',
                    EA1calledthings = 'CTQ3',
                    PN3drunkhigh = 'CTQ4',
                    EN1specimp = 'CTQ5',
                    PN4dirtyclothes = 'CTQ6',
                    EN2loved = 'CTQ7',
                    EA2wasntborn = 'CTQ8',
                    PA1hitdoctor = 'CTQ9',
                    PA2bruises = 'CTQ11',
                    PA3hitobject = 'CTQ12',
                    EN3helpfulfam = 'CTQ13',
                    EA3insults = 'CTQ14',
                    PA4phyabused = 'CTQ15',
                    PA5hitnoticed = 'CTQ17',
                    EA4felthated = 'CTQ18',
                    EN4closefam = 'CTQ19',
                    SA1sextouch = 'CTQ20',
                    SA2sexthreat = 'CTQ21',
                    SA3sexdowatch = 'CTQ23',
                    SA4molest = 'CTQ24',
                    EA5emotabuse = 'CTQ25',
                    PN5doctor = 'CTQ26',
                    SA5sexabuse = 'CTQ27',
                    EN5famsup = 'CTQ28'
                  )

```

```{r Re-code categorical variables}


clean_data_5 <- clean_data_4 |> 
                    mutate (ID = as.character(ID),
                      Sex = fct_recode(as.factor(Sex), male = "1", female = "2"),
                      Ethnicity = fct_recode(as.factor(Ethnicity), NH = "1", Hisp = "2"),
                      Race = fct_recode(as.factor(Race), Black = "3", White = "5"),
                      College_Year = fct_recode(
                        as.factor(College_Year),
                        freshman = "1",
                        sophomore = "2",
                        junior = "3",
                        senior = "4",
                        posbac = "5",
                        other = "6"
                      ))

```


```{r Change Age Decimals}

cleaned_data_6 <- clean_data_5 |> 
                    mutate (Age = format(round(Age, 0), nsmall = 0)) 
```


```{r}

View (cleaned_dataset_6)  
```


```{r Save Cleaned Dataset}

write_csv(cleaned_data_6, "data/processed/clean_CTQ_SEM_data.csv")

```
